author: Pookiebeertje
quote: To me, this game just hit all the right sweet spots all at once. This game, unlike many other games being released these days, didn't try to be everything all at once. It held true to what made the original game amazing, and it stays that way. Not much else needs to be said. If you know why Ocarina of Time, the original version, is as great as it is, you will know why this game will be even greater. Not only are the visuals extremely stunning, the characters extremely well developed and the world building extremely well executed, I am just at a loss of words for how well Nintendo implemented such an old game into an extremely fresh, new, modern look.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Pookiebeertje
quote:
I have to start it with saying I'll explain my score. This game, when started up, had an extremely slow start, a start which I thought, okay, this will rapidly increase in speed. However, after only playing for 4 hours, I already immediately realized the very big flaws that hindered the performance of this game. In my opinion, these flaws may include, but are not only limited by, the extremely tedious tasks, annoying quests, and for lack of a better term, spiceless things to do.

Not only did I start out with just the quests, I'll be talking about the characters now. The characters are dull, bland, not well-written, and are clearly not as thought out as they should be for a game that has been in development for over seven years.
With most of the characters feeling like they're extremely based, and extremely average character. Nothing remarkable, or something that reminds me of them, nor something that will stick with me after having experienced these characters.

As for the map, I think the layout in terms of streets and functioning property places, like stores, I think the layout is okay, even though it could have been better with a more organized layout, meaning a more efficient way to traverse, more efficient way to get from one place to the other because sometimes it feels tedious going from the barber, to the gym, etc. When talking about the graphics, I wouldn't call them revolutionary, but they're definitely a step in the right direction, although we have already seen these graphics with, for example, Black Myth: Wukong, The Last of Us, and Horizon Forbidden West. Those games are extremely well and good made.

In conclusion, this game just felt like it tried to be everything all at once, but just failed on most aspects with delivering a mediocre experience for anyone. This for me, the mediocrity of this game, plus the fact that how much money they have spent and the amount of developers and the amount of time they have got to release this, plus the delays, make it for me a zero out of ten game!
